name: handihotel
description: HandiHotel — Full-scale 3D multiplayer browser game inspired by classic Habbo Hotel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @handihotel/server" "npm run dev -w @handihotel/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @handihotel/shared && npm run build -w @handihotel/server && npm run build -w @handihotel/client
